shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A man in a green shirt sits on the sink-side guest stool and announces that the breakfast chores need to be divided, while a woman in a white shirt sits on the sink-side cook stool, and a woman in a blue shirt sits on the refrigerator-side cook stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and both cook-side stools in frame.

shots.content: A woman in an orange shirt enters and sits on the refrigerator-side guest stool. She asks how the morning housekeeping will be handled, and a man in a green shirt replies that breakfast will be easy to prepare.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt asks if all the breakfast tasks are finished, and a man in a green shirt admits that the work is more difficult than expected.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and both cook-side stools in frame.
